title: CyclicJudge: Mitigating Judge Bias Efficiently in LLM-based Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2603.01865v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM-as-judge evaluation has become standard practice for open-ended model assessment; however, judges exhibit systematic biases that cannot be averaged out by increasing the number of scenarios or generations. These biases are often similar in magnitude to the model differences that benchmarks are designed to detect, resulting in unreliable rankings when single-judge evaluations are used. We introduce a variance decomposition that partitions benchmark score variance into scenario, generation, judge, and residual components. Based on this analysis, CyclicJudge, a round-robin assignment of judges to scenarios, is demonstrated to be the optimal strategy for a fixed judge panel and judge-call budget: it cancels the average additive judge offsets while matching the cost of single-judge evaluation. translated_title: CyclicJudge：高效缓解基于大语言模型评估中的评审偏差
translated_abstract: 以大语言模型作为评审（LLM-as-judge）的评估方式已成为开放式模型评估的标准做法；然而，评审模型存在系统性偏差，这种偏差无法通过增加场景或生成样本的数量来平均消除。这些偏差的量级往往与基准测试所要检测的模型差异相当，因此使用单一评审进行评估会导致不可靠的排名。我们提出了一种方差分解方法，将基准测试分数的方差分解为场景、生成、评审和残差四个组成部分。基于这一分析，我们证明CyclicJudge——一种评审模型与场景之间的循环轮换分配策略——是在固定评审小组和评审调用预算条件下的最优策略：它能够在与单评审评估成本相同的前提下，消除评审模型的平均加性偏移。在MT-Bench和MindEval上的实验结果如预期般验证了CyclicJudge的有效性，无论是在通用领域还是特定领域场景中均表现良好。
tldr: 该论文提出方差分解分析方法，并证明CyclicJudge循环轮换评审策略能在与单评审评估相同的成本下有效消除大语言模型评审的系统性偏差，从而获得更可靠的模型排名。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a variance decomposition analysis and demonstrates that CyclicJudge, a round-robin assignment of judges to scenarios, is the optimal strategy for canceling systematic judge bias at the same cost as single-judge evaluation, yielding more reliable model rankings.
